metadata.title: Facets of the X-ray polytope of doubly stochastic matrices
metadata.abstract: We study the polytope of anti-diagonal X-rays of k x k doubly stochastic matrices, the image of the Birkhoff polytope under the map that sums the entries along each anti-diagonal. Its facets other than the coordinate facets are the minimal joint tail bounds for lattice laws of a sum of two dependent uniform random variables. We give an exact facet criterion in terms of the allowed edges of a tight graph. For rays of the underlying tropical fan, total support of the tight graph suffices for a facet but is not necessary, as an example with k=19 shows. Up to affine functions and positive scaling, the potentials that define a facet form a polytope whose vertices are its rays. Facets propagate by padding and by grid refinement under explicit hypotheses. We give infinite families of facets from no step potential, facets of quadratic height, superpolynomially many facets, and a classification of three-step potentials. Total support of a step potential is characterized by a Hall-type condition on block starts; with computer assistance, total support decides facets of step potentials for k<=26. The facet counts up to k=12 are found directly for k<=3 and, for k>=4, come from an enumeration by a provably complete algorithm; an independent exact recomputation reproduces its ray lists for 5<=k<=12.

analysis.progressType: 多面体刻画与计算枚举
analysis.workSummary: 研究双随机矩阵反对角线和组成的 X-ray 多面体，用紧图及势函数刻画其非坐标面。
techniques: 热带扇与 Hall 型条件
analysis.breakthrough: 给出精确面判据、面传播及多种无限族；展示全支撑只是部分情形的充分条件，并以 k=19 例子排除其一般必要性。
analysis.limitations: k≤26 的阶梯势结论含计算辅助；k≤12 的枚举与较大 k 的结构定理应分开，不能把有限验证改写成任意阶结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
